text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with 
Verxina. She continued her special 
training to become a Queen, but—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I just need to pull this sign up, 
right?! —Heh. What a trivial trouble to 
solve.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haa!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Before my physical might, something 
like this is... nothing at all!

text_block_list.name: Troubled Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text:
...Th-Thank you so much... Y-You saved 
me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since she began emulating a queen, 
Verxina has taken the initiative like 
this. While people certainly appreciate 
it, however...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer. I'm... being a little strange, 
aren't I...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From Mejiro Ramonu to Kawakami Princess. 
Lately, Verxina had been imitating many 
"queens" whenever she went out. But—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Lately, how should I put it... It seems 
the various images of a 'Queen' have 
become all jumbled up inside her."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...I know. I've noticed the bewildered 
looks everyone has been giving us, too.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Things were going so well up until the 
middle... I wonder what went wrong—

text_block_list.name: Operations Staff
text_block_list.text:
What am I gonna doooo?! There's no time 
left~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: !? —Um, is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Operations Staff
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Um, about running the "Parent-Child 
Sing-Along Stage"! One of the performers 
just fell ill moments ago!

text_block_list.name: Operations Staff
text_block_list.text:
I've been looking for someone who's great 
at singing and dancing, but I haven't 
found anyone at all~...

text_block_list.name: Operations Staff
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, huh?! Is that... could it be... 
Verxina?!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. That is true, butâ

text_block_list.name: Operations Staff
text_block_list.text:
You're exceptionally good at both singing 
and dancing, aren't you? I saw you, after 
all! At the concert!! It was so beautiful 
and captivating...!!

text_block_list.name: Operations Staff
text_block_list.text:
Um, please!! For the sake of the children— 
won't you please take the stage?!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry for bringing this up out of the 
blue, Trainer. However, after being 
pleaded with like that...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I am at a loss. Just what kind of 
'Queen' should I be on stage—"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Just my usual self?
choice_data_list:
They made the request after seeing the 
usual you, after all.

They made the request after seeing the 
usual you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. Then let us face this as my 
true self for now.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
H-Hello. I'm Verxina. Thank you... for 
gathering here today!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: "Yay!" "Hellooo!!" "Hello, big sister!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(! ...Oh, this brings back memories. It 
reminds me of when Vivlos and the others 
were little—)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
――Now then! Before we get to the song, a 
quick check! Does everyone know "Umapyoi 
Densetsu"?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
"I know it!" "I might not know it..." 
"Maybe just a little bit?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Well then, shall we start by 
practicing so that everyone can enjoy it?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Now, copy what Big Sister does, okay? 
—Ready, and! Umapyoi, umapyoi!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: "...Umapyoi, Umapyoi?" "Umapyoi, Umapyoi."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're doing wonderfully. Come on, 
once more! Ready, and... Umapyoi, Umapyoi!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: "Umapyoi, Umapyoi!" "Umapyoi, Umapyoi!!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, you've gotten so much better! 
Alright, let's keep this momentum for the 
other callouts... onto the real deal!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ooh, Umadacchi!! Oooh?

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: "Umapyoi!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, she took the initiative 
to hype up the kids, turning the venue 
into an enormous success.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—Phew... Thank you for your hard work, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Waaah!!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
"You're so good at singing, Big Sis~!" "I 
copied you and danced a whole bunch!" "It 
was so much fun!!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
My, my! ...Fufufu! As long as everyone 
enjoyed themselves, that's what matters.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. The children, and even their 
parents! They were all delighted, copying 
the chants and claps.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer-san. You've really opened 
my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Even just being myself—staying true to who 
I am— I can still become a role model for 
someone, can't I?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Even without imitating anyone else. My 
ideal—lies beyond myself.
choice_data_list:
I ended up following your lead and 
shouting too.
I took a cue from you and shouted out too.

Even without imitating anyone else. My 
ideal—lies beyond myself.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I feel as though I've managed to 
reclaim my original ideals.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I... shall make my path, my crown, shine 
brilliantly!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"Huh, you too, Trainer? Well, that 
is—fufufu."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
What a shame I couldn't spot you from the 
stage. ...Would you care to do it again in 
front of me?
